findings: EffectComposition makes the external composition boundary explicit: Batched remains the default and exact frozen reference, while QuiescentPhaseSequential applies the unchanged force fold after each complete Harness run before resampling.

RecursiveLearnerCoherentEffect is opt-in and chooses a unique recent candidate only from the existing unanswered-return lifecycle; its focused test confirms hold followed by expiry release and old-protocol isolation.

The frozen batched parent reproduced nine actual transitions and six opposing-output steps with exact replay, natural quiescence, zero propagation exhaustion, upper contact and escape, and no lower contact.
Sequential composition survived its discovery predicate with twenty-one actual transitions; coherent unresolved effect survived with eleven transitions and four opposing-output steps.
The complete composition was correctly falsified: twenty actual transitions and three opposing-output steps still produced no lower contact, no primary closure, and no perturbation recovery.
All 62 non-ignored core tests, 14 human-facing tests, and 14 adapter tests passed; two pre-existing adversarial core tests remained explicitly ignored.
residual_uncertainty: Sequential composition is counterfactual adapter evidence and cannot support an Academy capability claim because the official Academy force law remains batched.
The next causal uncertainty is why the coherent negative output transaction ends after four effects: answer, expiry, ambiguity, or descendant-owner turnover have not yet been separated.
Neither surviving mechanism is adopted or sufficient for complete one-joint control.
